title: NVIDIA board statement
summary: NVIDIA's board announced that an independent review would be conducted and said it had confidence in Jensen Huang and the leadership team at that time.

title: CEO transition announced
summary: NVIDIA announced that Jensen Huang had resigned effective immediately, Colette Kress would serve as interim CEO while retaining the CFO role, and Harvey C. Jones would become board chair. The board said it would search for a permanent CEO.
